title: のりうつれ！ひとだま
genre: ターン制タクティクス
concept: ひとだまは取った駒にのりうつり、その駒の動きになる。飛で取れば次は飛、桂で取れば次は桂。赤いマスは敵に狙われていて、互いに守り合う駒は取れない。どの順で取れば、次の体で次の駒に届くか、手数の限られた盤で順番を読み当てるのが核。
howToPlay: 光る点をタップして動く。敵の駒に重なると、のりうつってその駒の動きになる。赤いマスに止まらず、手数内に全部取る。
libraryDecision: 使わない。小さな盤の上で駒が跳ねて入れ替わるだけで、Canvas 2D の描画と自作の動きで十分なめらかに見せられ、3Dや物理を足しても順番を読む面白さは強まらないため。
soundDecision: BGMは入れず、考える静けさを残した。駒を打つ乾いたパチッという音と、のりうつるたびに一段ずつ高くなる上昇音で、連続で取れたときの気持ちよさを耳でも感じられるようにした。

improvements.found: 狙われた赤いマスが市松模様に溶けて読めない／守られていて取れない敵駒が見分けられない／第1夜は手数に余裕がありすぎて緊張がなく、のりうつった瞬間の手応えも薄い
improvements.changed: 盤を明るい木目にして狙われたマスを濃い赤＋斜線に、守られた駒は赤い点線枠と錠前の印に。手数の余裕を最短+1手（後半は最短ぴったり）に絞り、のりうつるたびに新しい体の名前・波紋・連続のりうつりのボーナスを出した
improvements.foundEn: Red watched squares blended into the checkerboard; guarded (untakeable) enemies looked like free ones; night 1 had too many spare moves and possessing felt weak
improvements.changedEn: Lighter wood board with dark red hatched watched squares; guarded pieces get a dashed red frame and a lock badge. Move budget tightened to best+1 (exactly best later), and each possession shows the new body name, a ripple, and a chain bonus

improvements.found: 罠の一手で即「道がとだえた」になるが、どの手が悪かったか分からない／やり直しても同じ失敗をくり返しやすく理不尽に感じる／「歩！」などの表示が上の手数表示に重なる
improvements.changed: やり直したとき、前回道がとだえた一手のマスを暗くして「前回の失敗」と印を残し、下に説明を出すようにした。のりうつりの表示は盤の上端より上に出ないようにした
improvements.foundEn: A trap move instantly ends in "No way through" but you cannot tell which move was wrong; retrying invites the same mistake and feels unfair; the "Rook!" pop overlapped the move counter
improvements.changedEn: On retry, the square of the move that failed last time is darkened and marked "last miss" with a short note below; possession pops stay below the top of the board

candidates.ideaEn: A wisp that takes on the movement of each enemy piece it captures; clear the board while avoiding watched squares, like a chess puzzle.

candidates.ideaEn: A sound playground: hang wind chimes under the eaves at night; their ringing changes with the wind paths. No goal, no end.

candidates.idea: 3Dの傘回し。傘をスワイプで回し、上で転がる鞠や升を落とさずに芸を続ける。
candidates.ideaEn: 3D umbrella spinning: swipe to spin a parasol and keep a ball or box rolling on top without dropping it.

en.title: Possess! Wisp Chess
en.concept: The wisp possesses each piece it captures and moves like it: take with a rook and you are a rook, take with a knight and you jump. Red squares are watched and pieces guard each other. The core is reading the order: which capture gives you the body that reaches the next piece, within a tight move limit.
en.howToPlay: Tap a glowing dot to move. Landing on an enemy possesses it and you move like it. Never stop on red squares; take them all within the move limit.
en.libraryDecision: None. A small board where pieces hop and swap is smooth with Canvas 2D and hand-made motion; 3D or physics would not strengthen the fun of reading the order.
en.soundDecision: No BGM, leaving quiet to think. A dry wooden clack for moves, and a rising tone that climbs one step with each possession, so chained captures feel good to the ear too.

aiReview.worst: 盤面は毎回自動生成なので、夜が進んでも変わるのは駒の数と盤の広さだけ。手作りの詰め将棋のような「ひらめきの一手」が毎回あるとは限らず、数夜続けると似た読み合いに感じる。
aiReview.comment: 第2夜で、取れる歩にすぐ飛びつくと即「道がとだえた」。やり直すと前回の失敗マスが暗くなっていて、先に角へのりうつり、長い斜めで敵の王を取って王の体になる道が見えたときは気持ちよかった。赤い斜線と錠前の印で、どこが危ないか・どれが取れないかは一目で分かる。ただ自動生成のため盤ごとの出来にむらがあり、★3とした。

similar.title: Echo Chess
similar.note: 取った駒になる、盤の駒を全部取る、という中心のルールが同じ。本作は狙われたマスと守り合い、手数制限、自動生成の夜と灯の数を加えた
similar.note_en: Same core rule: become the captured piece and clear the board. This adds watched squares, mutual guarding, a move limit, generated nights and lives.

similar.title: Solo Chess (Chess.com)
similar.note: 取る順番を読んで盤の駒を減らす一人用チェスパズル。本作は取ると動きが変わり、敵の利きを避ける必要がある
similar.note_en: Solo chess puzzle about capture order; here your movement changes with each capture and you must avoid enemy attacks.

aiReview.research: WebSearch で『capture piece become that piece chess puzzle』を検索し、itch.io の Echo Chess と Chess.com の Solo Chess を確認

en.worst: Boards are generated, so later nights only add pieces and a bigger board. Not every board has a hand-crafted 'aha' move, and after several nights the reading starts to feel similar.
en.comment: On night 2, grabbing the free pawn instantly gave 'No way through'. On retry the failed square was darkened, and finding the route — possess the bishop, take the enemy king down a long diagonal and become a king — felt great. Red hatching and lock badges make danger and guarded pieces readable at a glance. Generated boards vary in quality, so 3 stars.
en.research: Searched the web for capture-and-become chess puzzles; found Echo Chess (itch.io) and Chess.com Solo Chess.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 18 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 18 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: 錠前つきの角は取れないので、まず飛を狙って左下へ

playLog.note: 飛を取る。「飛！」と出て、体が飛に
飛で角を取る。2連のりうつりのボーナス

playLog.noteEn: Take the king: released in the shortest moves.

playLog.note: 取れる歩にすぐ飛びつく
playLog.noteEn: Grab the free pawn right away.

playLog.note: すぐに「道がとだえた」。歩になると王に近づけない罠だった
playLog.noteEn: Instantly 'No way through': as a pawn you can't approach the king. A trap.

playLog.note: 歩ではなく、先に左下の角を狙う
playLog.noteEn: Go for the bishop first instead of the pawn.

playLog.note: 角で一つ下がって、敵の王への斜め線を通す
playLog.noteEn: Step the bishop down to open a diagonal to the enemy king.

playLog.note: 長い斜めで王を取る。王の体になった
playLog.noteEn: Long diagonal capture of the king; now I'm a king.

playLog.note: 歩を取って成仏。最初に歩を取るのが罠で、王を角で取るのが鍵だった
playLog.noteEn: Take the pawn: released. Grabbing the pawn first was the trap; taking the king with the bishop was the key.

playLog.note: 第3夜。桂が出てきた。錠前つきの桂と角は後回しにして、守られていない飛を取る
playLog.noteEn: Night 3 adds a knight. Leave the locked knight and bishop; take the unguarded rook.
